_comment: Local development overrides only. NO SECRETS are committed here: the application runtime account is the least-privilege SQL login 'sigea_app', and its password is substituted from the SIGEA_APP_PASSWORD environment variable at startup (see DAL/SchoolContext.cs). Never commit a filled-in password. This file does not apply to Azure SQL Managed Instance deployments, which use Managed Identity (see appsettings.json).
